items.q: she wasn't no Mary Lou Williams

ctx.x: Yes, she was -- she was playing right along with the band. I mean, she wasn't no Mary Lou Williams, but she did a beautiful job. I mean, she did the job, you know. Oh, and some other guys that I would like to remember out of that band, which were good musicians, you know? But
that was the first time I --

items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: When Mary Lou got sick, they sent for her to play in Mary's place. Yes, she could handle a job, you know. I didn't enjoy -- I enjoyed her playing, but I didn't think she could really outplay Mary.

ctx.x: Was she a good piano player?

Yes, she could play. When Mary Lou got sick, they sent for her to play in Mary's place. Yes, she could handle a job, you know. I didn't enjoy -- I enjoyed her playing, but I didn't think she could really outplay Mary.
No, well, there weren't many people that could.
